化神 menu shows 随当前境界, 元婴 Lv1 and 化神 Lv2 only. Higher realm entries are absent, rather than clickable disabled placeholders.
Gold selected-state highlight changes to 化神 Lv2, 地仙 Lv6, 元婴 Lv1 and then 随当前境界 after actual production screen mouse clicks. The separate ordinary hover highlight can be visible on another row.

Saved TOML reads confirm real production preference persistence. Reopening the page preserves automatic selection. The fixture restores original DEV animation, pose and appearance preference values.
A real C2S packet requesting 地仙 appearance at actual 化神 is clamped by the production server to 化神. Automatic preference remains encoded as 0 and resolves to current actual realm.
limits: Isolated DEV local save, native renderer, 1280x720 at GUI scale 2. No remote multiplayer client, shader-pack, FPS or arbitrary display-size claim.
Reflection only reads widget coordinates, production packet snapshots and the renderer resolver; all preference selections in the evidence use actual production screen mouseClicked/mouseScrolled.

No actual world-unload/cache-reset PASS claim. An optional clearLevel step in the earlier candidate blocked during server terrain generation; that candidate and its thread dump remain preserved separately. The final fixture ends with normal Minecraft.stop after completing requested UI verification.
Images are actual Minecraft outputs. Preview only resizes and labels originals; it does not paint or synthesize gameplay effects.
